stories.title: Trump pivots back to sanctions for Iran as other strategies to end his war fizzle
stories.description: The shift comes as U.S. stockpiles of key weapons have dwindled and as stop-start talks seem again to have stalled. But Trump insists the pressure can lead to a breakthrough.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
stories.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

stories.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
stories.description: Iran's proxy says it hit a ship with Saudi military equipment in the Red Sea, as tensions over the US-Iran war remain high.

stories.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after two soldiers killed by explosion
stories.description: Lebanese authorities says one person was killed in the strikes, which came after the first Israeli military fatalities in Lebanon in more than a month.

stories.title: Iranian footballers who defied Tehran become Australian citizens
stories.description: There were among seven to be granted humanitarian visas while playing in Australia - but the other five changed their minds and returned to Iran.

stories.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
stories.description: Neither the US or Oman have commented on the proposed agreement on the vital waterway.

stories.title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
stories.description: The Houthis say they launched missiles and drones at "Saudi military build-ups" in the central provinces of Marib and Hadramawt.

stories.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
stories.description: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

stories.title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
stories.description: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

stories.title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
stories.description: The US president claims Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked Washington to hold off on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed.

stories.title: Qatar says US-Iran mediation efforts continuing but no direct talks planned
stories.description: There have been conflicting signals from the US and Iran, with Tehran denying President Trump's assertion that talks are under way.

stories.title: Trump boarded secret flight via catering truck due to Iran threat, US media reports
stories.description: President Donald Trump took a secret military flight from Turkey last month in an operation that involved him being moved between aircraft in a catering truck, an extraordinary deception prompted ​by an Iranian assassination threat, the Washington Post reported.

stories.title: 🔴 Lebanon becomes first Middle Eastern country to abolish death penalty
Lebanon becomes first Middle Eastern country to abolish the death penalty
stories.description: Lebanon on Tuesday became the first Middle East country to formally abolish the death penalty, replacing the sentencing with life imprisonment plus aggravated hard labour. Lebanon had not carried out an execution since 2004.

stories.title: Pakistan interior minister in Tehran amid talks to reopen Hormuz
stories.description: Pakistan’s interior minister Mohsin Naqvi has held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Tehran.

stories.title: US military fires on cargo vessel it said sought to break Iran blockade
stories.description: CENTCOM says helicopter fired at engine room of Panama-flagged Vela Nova as US-Iran diplomacy remains stalled.

stories.title: Rights groups launch new legal challenge to Trump campaign against ICC
stories.description: Prominent organisation charge sanctions against international tribunal trample consitutional rights, hinder their work.

stories.title: Ousted Syrian president Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
stories.description: A Syrian court on Tuesday sentenced former ruler Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia, after convicting him over charges of “war crimes” and “crimes against humanity” during the country’s civil war. stories.description: DUBAI: US President Donald Trump on Monday demanded Iran pay compensation for the deaths of people he said it had killed in wars, attacks and protests, raising the rhetorical stakes with Tehran as hopes faded for an imminent deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. stories.description: Father after father AFP spoke to in Afghanistan about the education ban that stops their daughters from going beyond primary school choked up in despair. stories.description: BERLIN: Germany faces daily hybrid warfare attacks from abroad, Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt was quoted by a local newspaper as saying on Sunday, following a suspected attack attempt involving an explosive-laden drone at Leipzig/Halle Airport. stories.description: After boarding the legacy Air Force One jet in Ankara in view of television cameras, Donald Trump was secretly shuttled minutes later to a smaller plane — an Air Force C-32A — via an airport catering truck typically used to load meals and other supplies
